subject: Unknown package "x" when deploying on shinyapps.io

messages.author: efa65b3685462b33
messages.subject: Unknown package "x" when deploying on shinyapps.io
parts:
Dear Sirs,

I would appreciate your help dealing with the following issue:

"Error:
* Application depends on package "x" but it is not installed. Please resolve before continuing."

It has happened when I was trying to deploy an app on shinyapps.io, despite the app runs ok on my computer, including on browser.

There are only 2 libraries required, both present in ui.R and server.R scripts:

library(shiny)
library(seewave)

Being so, how to identify package "x" and to solve the problem?

I would appreciate any help you could provide me.

Kind Regards,

Normand.

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: Unknown package "x" when deploying on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

When you run deployApp() any source files that in the directory are examined for dependencies. Dependencies are considered any call to library(), or require() or any package called like somepackage::somefunc()

Please double check that you have no extra source files in your app directory with that dependency. 

-Andy
